caption: The drawing features several distinct objects arranged symmetrically on a textured beige background. At the top, there is a stylized cross colored with red, yellow, and light blue, with yellow rays or lines radiating outward from behind it. Below the cross, a large bow-like shape with four teardrop-shaped loops outlined in blue and filled with red and yellow is centered, with a circular medallion at its middle. Extending from each side of the bow are two symmetrical gold shapes with three red tips, resembling feathers or stylized leaves. Beneath the bow and cross is a large circular disc filled with a radial mandala pattern in red, yellow, and blue, consisting of repeating petal and chevron shapes arranged around a yellow and blue central dot. The composition is vertically aligned and uses a consistent color palette of red, yellow-gold, and light blue, with clean lines and solid fills.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
